subject: Airbridge crew consolidation — rapid reroute & staggered night-shift lodging
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: SkyLink Logistics <ops@skylinklogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Airbridge crew consolidation — rapid reroute & staggered night-shift lodging

Hi SkyLink team (and ops),

Quick situation: we just had a last-minute cancellation on the LAX->SEA shuttle for a core field crew supporting Aventis Cloud tomorrow evening. We need an urgent re-route and consolidated airbridge for 6 people with staggered night-shift check-ins so the on-site handover doesn't overlap. Full manifest attached (manifest.csv).

Requirements:
- 6 pax departing LAX between 17:00–20:00 PDT (flexible if necessary)
- Preferred arrival window in SEA: 19:30–23:00 local so the night team can split into two handovers (3 pax arriving earlier, 3 later)
- 2 hotel blocks: early shift (3 people) to check-in at ~21:30, late shift (3 people) to check-in ~00:30–01:00
- Ground shuttle: one small bus for early arrivals (21:45 pickup), one shuttle for late arrivals (01:15 pickup) — both to the same hotel load-in point
- Cost estimate and PNRs by EOD today; if charters are required, include lead time and incremental cost

Constraints: Aventis requires full name + DOB for manifests (included), and we need refundable/transferable fares if possible. We can approve small premium for same-day availability but want cheapest viable option.

Can you confirm options A/B/C for routing and hold provisional PNRs? Also loop Hotel Pacific (cc below) to place a soft hold on two 3-person rooming blocks while we decide.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Field Events Lead | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0199
From: SkyLink Logistics <ops@skylinklogistics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Airbridge crew consolidation — rapid reroute & staggered night-shift lodging

Hi Tessa — thanks for the details and the manifest.

We can support this today with two feasible options:

Option A (commercial mix) — lower cost, fastest to confirm
- 4x seats on AA 1732 LAX->SEA departing 18:05, arriving 20:02
- 2x seats on Delta 5480 LAX->SEA departing 19:40, arriving 21:35
- Shuttle scheduling fits: early pickup 21:45, late pickup 01:15 via partner shuttle vendor
- Estimated total fee (incl. seat holds + shuttle): $2,450
- Lead time: immediate; provisional PNRs provided on request

Option B (one-way charter leg + commercial) — higher cost but guaranteed split arrival windows
- Small charter LAX->SEA (3 pax) departing 17:30, arriving 19:05 (early group)
- Remaining 3 pax on commercial 21:15 dep, arrive 23:05 (late group)
- Dedicated ground transport for both groups, includes crew assist at arrivals
- Estimated total fee: $9,800 (charter minimums)
- Lead time: min 3 hours to confirm charter

Option C (all commercial, later arrivals) — lowest cost but tight handover window
- All 6 on 19:40–21:35 and 20:05–22:00 routings; may compress handover
- Estimated fee: $1,920

Attached: skylink_quote_0427.pdf with line items.

Action items for you: please confirm preferred option (A/B/C) and whether refundable fares are required. If you pick Option B we need authorization to book the charter.

Regards,
Morgan Lee
Ops Manager, SkyLink Logistics
ops@skylinklogistics.com
Attachment: skylink_quote_0427.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hotel Pacific Reservations <sales@hotelpacific.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, SkyLink Logistics <ops@skylinklogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Airbridge crew consolidation — rapid reroute & staggered night-shift lodging

Forwarding — Hotel Pacific, can you place a soft hold for 3 rooms (double occupancy) arriving 2027-04-14 for early group (check-in ~21:30) and 3 rooms arriving 2027-04-15 for late group (check-in ~00:30 local, list as 04-15) — we will confirm by 16:30 PT today.

Attached is the crew manifest and the quote from SkyLink. Please hold the following provisional rate if availability allows: $169/night standard king/queen, free shuttle pickup at the airport between 21:30–22:00 and again for scheduled 01:15 pickup. If you cannot reserve the late check-ins under 04-15 start date, please advise alternative hold instructions.

Also note: Aventis requires invoice to reference "Aventis Cloud — Redwood Inference (HV-2027-4872)" for expense reconciliation.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Field Events Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: updated-rooming.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, SkyLink Logistics <ops@skylinklogistics.com>, Hotel Pacific Reservations <sales@hotelpacific.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Airbridge crew consolidation — rapid reroute & staggered night-shift lodging

Thanks all — I reviewed options. Approving Option A (commercial mix) to keep costs reasonable and confirm by EOD.

Notes for ops: please hold provisional PNRs for both flights listed in Option A and secure refundable holds if available. If you hit any non-refundable restriction, tag those seats and flag to me immediately.

Hotel Pacific — please place soft holds for two groups as requested. We will finalize rooming by 16:30 PT and will share the final list in updated-rooming.pdf (attached).

Logistics (Logan/Priyom): I'll coordinate shuttle manifesting once SkyLink returns PNRs — priority is to keep the early group out of the 00:00 handover.

Marissa Cole
Field Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
